title: camtrapEvents: Metadata-Aware Independence Filtering for Camera-Trap Data
description: An R package that collapses repeated camera-trap records into independent detection events. Conventional filters use a fixed time threshold alone, which cannot distinguish an animal lingering in front of the camera from the arrival of new individuals. This package lets the independence decision also use record-level metadata such as group size, age and sex counts, behaviour or individual identity, and distinguishes counting encounters from counting individuals.
